Fixed in commit 044ae75. Added `@libsql/client` and `better-sqlite3` as direct dependencies to `apps/studio/package.json`. This ensures the packages are installed in the local `node_modules` during Vercel deployment, allowing the dynamic import in TursoDriver's lazy connection factory to resolve correctly.

The previous approach of copying from the monorepo root didn't work because pnpm's strict node_modules structure doesn't hoist scoped packages. With these packages now as direct dependencies of the studio app, Vercel will include them in the serverless function deployment.

> @claude[agent] 继续

Updated pnpm-lock.yaml in commit df3efb4. The CI was failing because the lockfile was out of sync after adding @libsql/client and better-sqlite3 dependencies to apps/studio/package.json. The lockfile has been regenerated and the CI should now pass.

Fixed in commit 466e085. The infinite recursion occurred because `better-sqlite3` and `@libsql/client` are now direct dependencies in apps/studio/package.json (added in 044ae75), so pnpm installs them automatically into apps/studio/node_modules/. The build script was trying to copy these packages from the monorepo root to a location that already existed, causing the recursive loop.

Removed the redundant copy logic for these two packages since they're now installed directly by pnpm. Only @ai-sdk packages still need to be copied since they remain workspace dependencies.

> @claude[agent] The framework produced an invalid deployment package for a Serverless Function. Typically this means that the framework produces files in symlinked directories. Please verify the framew...

Fixed in commit e5d5c8d. Vercel rejects symlinked directories in serverless function packages. pnpm creates symlinks in node_modules by default, which caused the "invalid deployment package" error.

The build script now dereferences these symlinks by:
1. Using `readlink -f` to get the real path the symlink points to
2. Removing the symlink
3. Copying the actual files with `cp -rL` to replace the symlink

This ensures @libsql/client, better-sqlite3, and @ai-sdk packages are real files that Vercel can package correctly.

Fixed in commit 1fa5437. The symlink dereferencing approach wasn't sufficient because pnpm creates a complex symlink structure throughout node_modules.

The proper solution is to configure pnpm to use `node-linker=hoisted` in apps/studio/.npmrc. This tells pnpm to create a flat, traditional node_modules structure with real directories instead of symlinks. Vercel can now package the serverless function correctly without encountering any symlinked directories.

This is the standard approach for Vercel deployments with pnpm monorepos.
